notes.title: ◆Large edition trial version and Ver1.2.2 update!
notes.content:
We have received a lot of feedback from people who have played Tokyo Game Dungeon, saying, ``It's fun to actually play!'', so we've prepared a large•scale trial version!
The only character you can use is RUI·K, but you can play all three stages!

Additionally, we have updated the product version to improve the UX and fixed bugs based on the feedback we received.
Enjoy RGS, which has become easier to play!
[Modification details]
· Added option to swap 〇×(AB) buttons
·Improved reroll UI
·Improved magnet function
·Increase the number of rankings displayed
·Fixed so that pipo that was not displayed in some resolutions is displayed.
·Other minor bug fixes
┗As a result of bug fixes, it is now easier to level up than before.
*Please forgive me for using automatic translation for announcements as we are a small team.

notes.title: ◆Ver1.2.0 update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have added an update to the world ranking!
Let's challenge Speedrun!

[Update contents]
・Implementation of world ranking of clear time
└Rankings for each stage can be displayed from the ranking tab
*Individual fastest times will be reset with the Ver1.2.0 update.
*Upgrade and achievements will not be reset.
・Improved design of skill acquisition screen
└Skill level upper limit display
└Icon display of weapon attributes, movements, and possessed skill attributes
・Implementation of play guide
└Displayed from the button on the title screen/pause screen

[Modification details]
・Fixed a bug where RUI・K was selected instead of the character you used when you returned to the home screen after a challenge.
・Fixed the unexpected behavior of the Demon General.
・Fixed an unintended design on the result screen
・Fixed unexpected behavior of SASAKI・MK2
・Fixed a bug where Demon Lord would not appear under certain conditions

notes.title: Ver1.1.0 Rogue Addition Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We've released the Rogue addition update!

The winning character [b][MUKOMON][/b] from the SpeedRun event held during SteamNextFest has arrived!
Take on SpeedRun challenges with this new character, who dashes across the field while throwing wrenches!

[h2]Rogue Introduction:[/h2]
MUKOMON works hard every day with safety first. His partner is a monkey wrench!
He possesses a Special Skill that transforms his weapon into a giant monkey wrench that he throws at enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108572/2a2785904236faace01f3ec611d3f5ff707b18e4.png[/img]

We are thrilled that so many people played the demo at SteamNextFest!
Now, we’d like to introduce the top three players with the best times!

[h3]1st 1:30.41 伝説の巨人むこもん 
2st 1:43.02 sio
3st  2:07.04 くらげ茶ぷりん[/h3]

Congratulations!

In the next Ver1.2.0 update, we plan to implement a World Ranking that lets you compete with users worldwide.
Sharpen your skills and get ready to aim for the top global rank!
*Note: Personal best times will be reset in the Ver1.2.0 update.
Permanent upgrades and achievements will not be reset.

notes.title: RGS Next Fest Cup Announcement
notes.content:
“Compete! Survivors! We will implement the fastest conqueror character! ”
RGS Next Fest Cup held!

◆Event Details
You will compete for the fastest time on the RTA stage implemented in the Next Fest limited trial version.
Event period: 10/14-10/21 10:00 (PT)

◆Fest Stage Overview
・RTA stage where you compete to defeat 4 bosses as quickly as possible while defeating the surging enemies!
- Proceed in a straight line through the horizontally long stage and defeat the three Demon Generals sitting on the map in order to take on the Demon Load that appears.

◆How to Play
1: Install the trial version from the store page
2: Select stage 2 and play

◆Strategy
・Collect weapons and make your Special Skill even more powerful!
・Use permanent upgrade to shorten the time!

◆Reward Details
1st place: Implement the character with the fastest time on the time attack stage
Top finishers: Names will be listed in the Next Festival Cup ranking in the in-game credits
Participation Award: Your name will be listed in the in-game credits as a Next Festival Cup participant.

◆Application Method and Deadline
Upload your fastest video to YouTube and fill out the entry form.
*In addition to the above, there is no problem as long as you attach the URL of a video sharing service where the development team can check the content of your play.
*Please include the video from the start of play to the results screen.
[h2][[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf681-PMisEIpwUKyvGBU_SWWtsvPyAJBZdq1r1OAmU3ynoPw/viewform?usp=sf_link]Click here for application form[/url]][/h2]
Application deadline: 2024/10/21

◆ RGS Cheering Award
Credit the name of the person who posted the screenshot in the Steam thread.
▼ Click here for the thread
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2804020/discussions/0/4692280123603327607/

[Note] Regarding Character Implementation
- A character will be added with the name specified by the person who cleared it.
- Character appearance can be specified.
- Character designs and text will be created by the development team based on the information received.
- The initial weapon, command sword technique, etc. will have the same performance as the character used in the time attack stage, but the design can be changed, and the explanations displayed in the game will also be unique.
- Characters will not be implemented for a limited time, but will be permanently implemented in the game.
- Designs will be decided after consulting with the development team after the rankings are finalized.
- Regarding the timing of character implementation, there is a possibility that it will be addressed in an update after the product version is released.

*If there is no reply within one week after being contacted by the development team, the rights will be transferred to the second place winner.
*We cannot accept requests that infringe on copyright or portrait rights.
*About transfer of rights
If both parties agree, it is also possible for fans to take first place and implement other people's characters, such as implementing an influencer's character.

*Please forgive me for using automatic translation for announcements as we are a small team.

notes.title: Beta Test Start Announcement
notes.content:

We will be holding a beta test prior to the release!

Wednesday, September 4, 2024 to Saturday, October 12, 2024
* Players' game progress and data will be erased without notice during and at the end of the beta period. Please note this in advance.
